scene: At the transit tent, three strange rides await your departure.
picture: Side-view pixel art of a snow-covered transit station beside the striped tent. On the far left, a tethered hot-air balloon basket sits open. Left of centre, the lanky boy stands in orange puffer vest and white scarf. In the centre idles a propeller trolley. On the right, an empty chairlift seat dangles low.
